metadata.database: A Deeper China | Wudang decision layer

WDM01.guest_need: A visitor wants Wudang understood as a mountain, architectural and Taoist state-building system.
WDM01.hidden_need: Replace fantasy and kung-fu imagery with one verifiable historical question.
WDM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A system frame explains landscape, buildings and patronage better than a mystical highlights list.
WDM01.stop_condition: The visitor can connect mountain setting, architecture, Taoist practice and Ming patronage.
WDM01.low_energy_branch: Use one public heritage anchor and stop.
WDM01.body_cost: Low physical load, high interpretation load.

WDM02.guest_need: A visitor needs a realistic number of nights and a protected arrival/departure buffer.
WDM02.hidden_need: Prevent a mountain destination from becoming a rushed transfer and stair checklist.
WDM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A pacing decision protects weather, recovery and the actual heritage question.
WDM02.stop_condition: Arrival, departure, transfer and recovery capacity are explicit.
WDM02.low_energy_branch: Keep one base and one public route.
WDM02.rain_branch: Use current transport and indoor fallback before changing the plan.
WDM02.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high transfer sensitivity.

WDM03.guest_need: A visitor needs mountain movement matched to stairs, weather, cable-car and fitness limits.
WDM03.hidden_need: Translate scenic ambition into a safe, reversible day shape.
WDM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A movement method prevents a beautiful route from becoming an unsafe promise.
WDM03.stop_condition: The visitor knows the maximum exertion and the fallback if conditions change.
WDM03.low_energy_branch: Use the shortest confirmed public layer and remove exposed sections.
WDM03.rain_branch: Remove ridge, sunrise and cable-car assumptions; keep a protected public route.
WDM03.body_cost: Potentially high stairs, exposure and weather load.

WDM04.guest_need: A visitor wants meaningful public architecture without overpacking a mountain day.
WDM04.hidden_need: Choose one coherent heritage route instead of collecting buildings and viewpoints.
WDM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One route can connect building, slope and view without turning the day into a race.
WDM04.stop_condition: One architectural relationship between terrain, ritual and state is clear.
WDM04.low_energy_branch: Choose one accessible public heritage anchor.
WDM04.rain_branch: Use the confirmed low-exposure public branch.
WDM04.body_cost: Moderate stairs and walking; high weather sensitivity.

WDM05.guest_need: A non-religious visitor wants to engage Taoist places respectfully.
WDM05.hidden_need: Avoid consuming worship, ritual or practitioners as spectacle.
WDM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: An etiquette-led visit is deeper and safer than a sacred-site checklist.
WDM05.stop_condition: The visitor understands one public religious/architectural relationship and follows site rules.
WDM05.low_energy_branch: Choose one sacred/public anchor and stop.
WDM05.rain_branch: Use confirmed accessible indoor sites and remove exposed movement.

WDM06.guest_need: A visitor needs to distinguish observation, beginner movement, serious training and healing claims.
WDM06.hidden_need: Prevent a Tai Chi interest from becoming an unverified master or medical promise.
WDM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: An intent split protects safety, expectations and provider boundaries better than naming a teacher.
WDM06.stop_condition: Purpose, language, safety, venue, capacity, waiver and release status are clear.
WDM06.low_energy_branch: Use public observation; do not add physical practice.
WDM06.rain_branch: Only a confirmed indoor partner programme can be considered.

WDM07.guest_need: A visitor needs a base that protects sleep, food, early starts and weather recovery.
WDM07.hidden_need: Avoid hotel-list recommendations that ignore mountain logistics.
WDM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A recovery audit affects the route more than a fourth scenic stop.
WDM07.stop_condition: Base, meals, arrival, sleep and fallback capacity are acceptable.
WDM07.rain_branch: Default recovery and indoor contingency layer.
WDM07.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high operational sensitivity.

WDM08.guest_need: A visitor needs to know when the agent must stop and ask for human review.
WDM08.hidden_need: Turn uncertainty into a visible release decision rather than confident prose.
WDM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A release gate protects the guest better than adding more content.
WDM08.stop_condition: Dated evidence, unresolved risks and a fallback are recorded.
WDM08.low_energy_branch: Pause and retain only the safest public layer.
WDM08.rain_branch: Stop if access, weather or safety evidence is missing.
WDM08.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high liability sensitivity.
